requirement.statement: The system SHALL preserve provider/actor terminal authority and continue multi-turn WorkflowFulfill business context without deterministic semantic routing.

case.given: A workflow child has emitted partial assistant content and its next provider completion fails
case.then: The child and parent tool MUST report structured failure; the partial content MUST NOT become a successful final result

case.given: A synchronous WorkflowFulfill child is still running
case.when: The spawn command returns its wait control marker
case.then: The marker MUST NOT commit an empty tool result and childDone SHALL be the sole terminal writer

case.given: The workflow child terminal message is failed or cancelled
case.when: The parent and CLI project the business journey result
case.then: The result MUST contain a non-empty failure and MUST NOT report completed with a null failure summary

case.given: A later WorkflowFulfill turn confirms or adjusts a plan from earlier conversation
case.when: A fresh dedicated workflow actor is spawned
case.then: The actor SHALL receive a bounded role-ordered projection of prior business conversation from Conversation Domain

case.given: Prior conversation includes discussion of publication or execution
case.when: The current structured invocation has publication or execution authorization false
case.then: The actor MUST treat the current structured booleans as authoritative and MUST NOT inherit authorization from historical text

case.when: It selects and bounds prior messages
case.then: It MUST use structural role/order/size rules and MUST NOT use regex, keyword or fuzzy business matching

requirement.statement: The AI Workflow Skill SHALL expose exact runtime effect capabilities while the model owns semantic tool and workflow design.

case.given: A workflow needs an external business effect
case.when: The workflow actor authors dynamic flow code
case.then: The model SHALL select the tool, arguments, parsing and failure policy from the system Skill without host natural-language matching

case.given: Dynamic flow code invokes the Eidolon effect provider
case.then: The operation MUST be one of identity, tool.call, ai.agent, material.read or material.write; registered web access SHALL use tool.call with webfetch

case.given: A multi-source workflow permits partial source degradation
case.then: The workflow MUST enter Failed and MUST NOT render an empty or fabricated success report
